markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
markets.description:

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: The wide-open 2028 presidential field keeps trader consensus fragmented, with JD Vance holding a modest lead at 23% due to his role as sitting vice president and early signals of party support. Speculation around Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez at 14% reflects Democratic positioning efforts amid a crowded primary landscape that includes governors and senators testing national viability through media and events. Marco Rubio and Jon Ossoff follow closely, underscoring competition within both parties before formal primaries begin. Key variables such as fundraising momentum, polling in battleground states, and potential endorsements or shifts in voter coalitions could widen gaps, while the extended timeline to nomination leaves room for late developments to alter implied probabilities.
